description_en: Deletes a security group rule that is configured for an ApsaraDB RDS for SQL Server instance
description_zh: 该接口用于删除RDS SQL Server实例已设置的安全组规则
kebab_example: aliyun rds delete-db-instance-security-group-rule --db-instance-id rm-bp15i4hn07r000000 --security-group-rule-ids sgr-2ze17u000000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DeleteDBInstanceSecurityGroupRule

parameters.help_en: The ID of the instance. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2628785.html operation to query the IDs of instances
parameters.name: db_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the security group rule. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2834044.html to obtain the ID of the security group rule
parameters.name: security_group_rule_ids

parameters.help_en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The token can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 用于保证请求的幂等性，防止重复提交请求。由客户端生成该参数值，要保证在不同请求间唯一，最大值不超过64个ASCII字符，且该参数值中不能包含非ASCII字符
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en: The ID of the resource group
parameters.name: resource_group_id

Message.description_en: The information about the status code
